## Invitations

The outreach recorded 1537 invitations and 172 attendances. This represents an attendance rate of 11.2 per cent among those invited. The figures provide a clear summary of participation and indicate that attendance was lower than the number of invitations issued. The attendance total is reported as part of the overall invitation and contact activity.

The report records attendance only in relation to the invitations listed above. No further breakdown of attendance is provided.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 1327 invitees. Reminder activity was recorded as 0. These figures distinguish between the number of people reached by SMS and the number of reminders issued.

The contact information is presented alongside the invitation and attendance figures to support a straightforward account of outreach activity. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
